def format_currency(n):
    # Handle negative numbers
    if n < 0:
        sign = '-'
        n = abs(n)
    else:
        sign = ''
    
    # Convert number to string
    num_str = str(n)
    
    # Add commas every 3 digits from the right
    formatted_num = format(int(num_str), ',')
    
    return f"{sign}${formatted_num}"
